name: Elemental Gem (Red Corundum)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Break the gem
powers.text: Magic action: break it and an Fire Elemental appears, friendly to you, for 1 hour.

summary: Break it to summon an Fire Elemental that obeys you for an hour.
text: Shattering this gem with a Magic action releases the elemental mote trapped inside, calling forth a Fire Elemental just as the Conjure Elemental spell would; the gem is then spent. The elemental takes the unoccupied space nearest the shards, treats you and your allies as friends, and follows your orders until it hits 0 Hit Points or 1 hour passes.
